prompt_en: A moody cinematic photograph of a small old-fashioned bedroom at night, viewed from bedside height. In the left foreground, a worn wooden bed with a dark headboard is covered by a faded patchwork quilt, with exactly 2 stacked floral pillows near the head of the bed. The walls are stained, cracked, and aged plaster in warm ochre tones, giving the room a lived-in, slightly neglected feeling. On the upper left wall hangs 1 framed vintage street-scene print, and near the center wall hangs 1 dark shoulder bag from a hook. Beside the bed is a small wooden nightstand lit by 1 warm glowing table lamp with a round shade, casting soft amber light and deep shadows across the room. On the tabletop sit exactly 5 visible objects: 1 red cylindrical tin, 1 small boxy container, 1 shallow cup or ashtray, 1 small round alarm clock, and the lamp itself. Beneath the nightstand is an open shelf with clutter. On the right side, a tall old window with dark wooden panes shows a deep blue nighttime exterior with a few distant blurry lights; the curtain is thin, worn, and partly drawn. On the windowsill are exactly 3 visible objects: 1 tall ceramic bottle, 1 dark glass bottle, and 1 vintage silver-and-black radio cassette player. At the lower right is 1 small stool or low table draped with newspapers, with more papers stacked underneath. The lighting should be low-key, tungsten warm indoors against cool blue night outside, with heavy film grain, soft focus, rich shadows, nostalgic realism, subtle dust, and the atmosphere of a quiet, lonely apartment from the late 1970s or 1980s.\

prompt_en: Design an infographic-style image of [OBJECT] that fuses a photorealistic render of the object with hand-drawn technical annotations layered directly on top. Render the annotations in black ink linework and matching text (architectural pen / technical manual look) sitting on a pure white studio backdrop. Style and layout: • The realistic object stays fully visible underneath the annotation layer • Annotations read as sketched, precise, architectural • Tidy composition with deliberate negative space • Vibe: engineering manual meets museum exhibit. Visual style: Minimal technical illustration aesthetic, crisp black linework over photoreal imagery, exacting yet slightly hand-drawn. Color palette: Pure white background, strictly black lines and text. No other colors. Output: 1080x1080, razor-sharp, optimized for social feeds, no watermark.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a clean anime-style male character design sheet for a modern Japanese office worker, with the character's face intentionally obscured by a soft square blur in every portrait.

Canvas: Wide horizontal character-reference sheet on a white background, approximately 16:9. Use thin black divider lines, neat Japanese editorial layout, and muted professional colors.

Layout: Place a left information column, three full-body character views across the center, and a right detail column. The overall look should resemble a polished commercial character settings document.

Left information column: At the top, draw a bordered profile card with exactly 4 labeled rows: name, occupation, height, and weight. Use Japanese text for the visible labels and values: 「名前: 高橋深月」 with small furigana above the name and “(Takahashi Mizuki)” underneath, 「職業: サラリーマン」, 「身長: 182cm」, 「体重: 68kg」. Below it, add a section titled 「キャラクター設定」 with exactly 4 bullet points describing him as a salaryman in his late twenties, calm and intellectual with a strong sense of responsibility, serious and trusted at work, and clean-looking with a trustworthy impression. At the bottom, add a section titled 「カラー設定」 with exactly 5 color swatches: hair light brown #8B6F5E, eyes brown #5A3E2B, suit gray #646A70, shirt white #FFFFFF, tie/shoes/belt black #111111.

Center character views: Show exactly 3 full-body views of the same man wearing a fitted gray business suit: left side view labeled 「側面図」, center front view labeled 「正面図」, and right back view labeled 「背面図」. The man is tall and slim, with light-brown center-parted hair, a white dress shirt, black slim tie with a tie pin, gray notch-lapel jacket, matching slim straight trousers with center crease, black belt, black dress shoes, and a simple analog wristwatch. In the side view, show one hand in pocket and a relaxed upright posture. In the front view, show one hand in pocket and the other relaxed at his side. In the back view, show the suit jacket seams and clean tapered silhouette.

Center annotation callouts: Add thin leader lines and Japanese labels pointing to the outfit and traits. Include callouts for hairstyle, expression, suit, necktie, pants, and shoes. The hairstyle note should describe a center part with naturally flowing hair; the expression note should describe a calm and slightly smiling trustworthy impression; the suit note should describe a crisp fitted silhouette; the necktie note should describe a black solid tie with tie pin; the pants note should describe slim straight slacks with a center crease; the shoes note should describe black straight-tip dress shoes.

Right detail column: Title the column 「ディテール」. Include exactly 4 rectangular detail panels stacked vertically: 1) close-up head and hair with blurred face, 2) close-up chest showing lapels, shirt, tie, tie pin, and pocket square, 3) close-up sleeve cuff and simple analog watch, 4) close-up fabric texture swatch. Add Japanese bullet notes beside these panels: bangs are center-parted and flow naturally, hair has neat straight texture, eyes are calm and composed, jacket has notch lapels and a pocket square, sleeves show four real buttons, watch is a simple analog type, fabric is a high-quality wool-blend suit material suitable for spring, autumn, and winter.

Bottom-right notes: Add a small bordered box titled 「備考」 with exactly 3 bullet points emphasizing cleanliness and trustworthiness, a basic refined business-suit style, and a simple but polished design.

Visual style: Semi-realistic anime illustration, clean line art, soft cel shading, realistic suit folds, elegant muted palette, magazine-like Japanese character sheet design, crisp legible typography, no decorative background, no watermark.\

Goal: Create a 3×3 Japanese meme-style process chart showing how an original character request mutates through a production pipeline, using the same turquoise-haired fantasy belly dancer/queen character across all panels. Make it humorous, polished, and information-dense, like a comparison sheet or comic grid.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 image with nine equal rectangular panels separated by thick black borders. Each panel has a white title strip at the top with bold black Japanese text and a circled number. Use a clean manga/illustration presentation with consistent margins.

Panel count and labels: Include exactly 9 panels, arranged left to right, top to bottom:
1. 「① クライアントが説明したキャラ設定」 — a childlike crayon sketch of the character, simple round face, long aqua hair, veil, gold jewelry, white dress, blue gem ornaments, uneven hand-drawn lines on paper.
2. 「② プロデューサーの理解」 — a refined but still relatively modest anime concept portrait of the turquoise-haired veiled dancer in a white-and-gold jeweled outfit, warm indoor lighting.
3. 「③ ディレクターの解釈」 — an exaggerated glamorous fantasy illustration with dramatic pose, sparkling purple cosmic background, lots of gold chains and turquoise gems, more sensual and overproduced.
4. 「④ クライアントへの説明・約束」 — a beautiful polished sales-pitch version, elegant magical lighting, butterflies or glowing particles, romantic pastel sparkle atmosphere, ornate jewelry and flowing veil.
5. 「⑤ 作られた設定資料」 — a professional character design sheet with exactly 2 full-body views of the character, front and back/side, plus multiple accessory diagrams of necklaces, chains, earrings, and turquoise-gold ornaments on a white background with small sketch notes.
6. 「⑥ イラストレーターのラフ」 — a monochrome rough pencil sketch of the character, energetic loose linework, long flowing hair and veil, jewelry indicated with scribbly detail, unfinished but dynamic.
7. 「⑦ 実際の成果物」 — make this an illustrated comic-book poster, not a 3D figure: bold saturated colors, thick ink outlines, pop-art halftone texture, the character transformed into a flashy “EXOTIC QUEEN!” cover-style pin-up with large turquoise hair, gold coins and jewelry, yellow-pink background, text reading “EXOTIC QUEEN!” in the upper left.

9. 「⑨ 本当にクライアントが欲しかったキャラ」 — the final desired character: elegant, mysterious, modestly sensual veiled fantasy queen in soft blue fabric, glowing lanterns, warm bokeh, delicate turquoise gems and gold chains, graceful pose and cinematic atmosphere.

She has very long aqua/turquoise hair, a translucent veil, ornate gold headpieces, turquoise gemstone accessories, layered necklaces, armlets, waist chains, and flowing pale blue or white fabric. Keep the same overall identity across all panels while changing the art style and interpretation per panel.

Add abundant sparkle, gold, turquoise, and ornate decorative motifs.

prompt_en: Create a cinematic visual titled: “THE PEOPLE WE BECOME.” The image should depict multiple stages of one human life existing simultaneously inside a single interconnected environment shaped by memory, growth and emotional transition. Avoid the feeling of: - a motivational poster, - a staircase timeline, - or separate portraits pasted together. Instead, the world itself should evolve naturally between life phases as if memories are physically blending into one another. The composition follows a winding stone pathway moving through different emotional spaces connected seamlessly across the image. At the bottom of the frame: A newborn sleeps inside a softly lit woven cradle near a dim bedside lamp. The atmosphere feels warm, silent and untouched. Nearby: - folded baby blankets, - soft shadows, - wooden toys, - faint moonlight through curtains, - dust particles drifting in warm air. The pathway slowly transitions into early childhood. A young child runs barefoot through a living room filled with scattered crayons, comic books, paper airplanes and half-built toy structures. Late-afternoon sunlight pours through large windows and reflects softly across wooden floors. The environment gradually changes again without hard separation. The next version appears around age 13: sitting alone on a rooftop during light rainfall wearing headphones and holding a notebook. Distant city lights blur softly behind him while unfinished sketches scatter beside him. The atmosphere becomes quieter and emotionally uncertain. Further along the path: A university-age version studies late at night at a cluttered desk illuminated only by a warm desk lamp and laptop screen. Around him: - highlighted textbooks, - coffee cups, - handwritten notes, - exhaustion, - ambition, - and isolation. Rain reflects softly across the apartment window behind him. At the highest point of the composition: An older version stands quietly overlooking a sunrise city skyline from a hillside path above the city. He looks calm rather than triumphant. His clothing is simple and grounded: rolled sleeves, slightly tired posture, hands in pockets, wind moving softly through his shirt. He should visibly feel like the same person shaped by every previous version. The transitions between life stages should contain subtle symbolic continuity: - flowers growing through cracks in concrete, - notebook pages blending into city architecture, - rainwater reflections becoming skyline lights, - old drawings faintly appearing on apartment walls, - childhood objects partially hidden inside later environments. Typography should remain minimal and restrained. Small serif text placed naturally near each stage: “Wonder.” “Becoming.” “Doubt.” “Discipline.” “Perspective.” No motivational quotes. No oversized typography. Lighting should evolve emotionally throughout the image: - warm soft childhood tones, - cooler rainy teenage atmosphere, - isolated tungsten lighting during study years, - balanced sunrise light in adulthood. The realism should feel grounded: - believable facial continuity across ages, - natural environmental texture, - subtle lens softness, - realistic lighting behavior, - physically believable spaces, - quiet cinematic atmosphere. The image should feel intimate and reflective rather than grand or overly dramatic. Mood: memory, identity, growth, loneliness, ambition, emotional evolution and the quiet passage of time.\

prompt_en: A retro Japanese movie poster for a fictional anime film, designed like an overdramatic 1980s to 1990s theatrical poster with intentionally tacky but charming pulp energy. The scene shows a teenage girl manga artist in a dim wooden Japanese room at night, seated on the floor beside a low desk covered with scattered manuscript pages, pens, ink, books, and drawing tools. She has messy dark shoulder-length hair blown by supernatural force, a cream-beige long-sleeve blouse with loose ruffles, and a dark plaid skirt. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She stretches one arm upward, holding a glowing smartphone toward a shattered window as a blinding explosion of light and lightning bursts through the glass, illuminating the whole room with gold-white energy. Outside the window is deep blue night with stormlike streaks and electric cracks. The composition is dynamic and diagonal, with the raised arm and device pointing into the central blast. Use painterly anime key art styling, dramatic rim light, textured film-poster shading, rich teal, navy, amber, and crimson colors, and a nostalgic hand-painted cinema-poster feel. Fill the poster with bold Japanese promotional copy in multiple blocks on the left side, including exaggerated red and yellow emphasis marks and three small cartoon reaction faces of a classic manga boy character. Add a vertical Japanese tagline on the right side. Place an enormous stylized Japanese title across the lower middle in red and blue metallic gradient lettering with sharp highlights and heavy shadow, reading トキヲ描ける少女. Include a cream starburst badge near the lower right with more Japanese text and a small manga face. At the lower left, add a large release date block in Japanese with bright yellow numerals and white text, defaulting to 2025年 7月18日(金). Along the bottom edge, add exactly 6 small rectangular film-strip preview stills from the movie. Add small production credits in Japanese and English across the bottom center, including Building Fictions. Make the whole layout feel like a fake time-travel comedy anime poster set in 1935, loud, nostalgic, cinematic, and slightly cheesy in the best possible way.\

prompt_en: Create a dramatic square commercial poster for a spicy snack brand, with a fiery red storm atmosphere and high-energy food advertising style. The background is a dark crimson sky filled with glowing clouds, scattered sparks, and visible lightning bolts. In the center, a giant tornado made of swirling transparent wind rings, glossy whole red chili peppers, square corn chips, crumbs, and seasoning particles rises upward from an opened snack bag, forming a powerful vortex. The tornado should feel dynamic and explosive, with chips and chili peppers flying outward in different sizes and depths for a cinematic 3D look. At the bottom center, place a glossy red snack packet standing upright, labeled with the brand logo and product name Crispy Nachos Chips, with a spicy flavor badge reading Spicy Masala, a small chili illustration, a corn note near the bottom, and a printed image of square nacho chips on the front. Put a stylized playful logo at the top left reading SnaX in bold yellow and white script with a red outline, and a clean white platform watermark at the top right reading Pollo.ai. On the left side, add a huge stacked distressed headline in bold condensed uppercase, with the first word in golden yellow and the remaining three lines in white, reading exactly: WARNING! CRUNCH STORM INCOMING. Use intense rim lighting, glossy highlights, deep shadows, rich red-orange color grading, and a premium snack advertisement composition that feels spicy, crunchy, chaotic, and irresistible.\

prompt_en: Create a hyper-realistic vertical fashion street photograph of a glamorous gyaru-style young woman walking in heavy rain at night outside a luxury hotel entrance, with a cinematic low-angle wide-lens perspective from near the wet pavement. She holds a transparent umbrella covered in raindrops above her head, her face intentionally covered by a plain brown rectangular privacy block. She has long wavy blonde hair cascading over her shoulders and wears a white cropped sleeveless top and cream pleated mini skirt, a thin gold chain belt, and glossy bright red knee-high monogram-pattern rain boots with chunky soles. One boot is planted on the reflective sidewalk while the other is lifted forward toward the camera, splashing water dramatically from the sole in a clear arc of droplets. She carries exactly 1 black designer-style shoulder bag with chain strap on her left shoulder, decorated with exactly 2 plush leopard-print teddy bear charms. Add jewelry details: bracelets, rings, manicured nails, and a confident fashion-model pose. The setting is THE PENINSULA hotel façade with warm golden entrance lights, stone architecture, glass canopy, lanterns, potted greenery, and a rain-soaked city street receding into the background with car headlights, neon reflections, and tall buildings. Emphasize wet skin texture, glossy boots, transparent umbrella ribs, sparkling raindrops, puddle reflections, bokeh city lights, and high-end editorial realism. Use dramatic perspective distortion, sharp foreground water splash, rich contrast, warm hotel lighting against cool rainy blue-black night tones, no extra people, no watermark.\

prompt_en: A dramatic Japanese horse racing champion poster in a cinematic, high-contrast, premium sports-advertising style. The main subject is a powerful dark bay to nearly black Thoroughbred racehorse with a glossy coat, a slightly windswept mane, and a small white star on its forehead, shown in a dominant three-quarter full-body pose facing right-of-camera. The horse wears racing tack and a deep blue saddlecloth marked with a large white number 7 and the horse name in Japanese, コントロール. Use a dark navy, black, and metallic gold color palette with glowing highlights, mist, sparks, and a night-sky atmosphere to create a legendary, triumphant mood. The layout should feel like an elite championship poster: oversized gold Japanese headline text at the upper left reading 三冠制覇。, with a smaller gold subtitle beneath it reading 「その名は、頂点の制御者。」. On the left side, include 3 laurel-wreath achievement callouts stacked vertically, each in gold: 1) 「皐月賞」 with smaller text 「中山競馬場 芝2000m」, 2) 「日本ダービー」 with smaller text 「東京競馬場 芝2400m」, 3) 「菊花賞」 with smaller text 「京都競馬場 芝3000m」. Across the bottom left to center, place the horse’s name in huge textured metallic gold Japanese lettering, コントロール, with the romanized name CONTROL in spaced serif capitals below it. Beneath that, add a pedigree line in gold Japanese text: 「牡・青鹿毛　父：チープコンパクト」. On the right side, add a large semi-transparent portrait of an older male trainer in a cap and glasses emerging from the dark background, serious and authoritative, with vertical white slogan text along the far right edge reading 「心を制し、レースを支配する。」. Near the trainer portrait, include handwritten-style white calligraphy for the trainer credit: 「調教師」 followed by a large signature-like name 夕造, and a smaller white phrase beneath: 「信念は、勝利を支配する。」. At the bottom right, show 3 smaller action panels or cutout scenes of the same horse racing with jockey, each tinted in cool blue tones and labeled in gold beneath them: 「皐月賞」, 「日本ダービー」, 「菊花賞」. The composition should be dense but elegant, with layered smoke, stadium lights, gold dust, and sharp contrast, resembling a luxury commemorative poster for a fictional Triple Crown racehorse.\

Her pose is casual and athletic: one leg straight, the other foot resting on a red-white-black football placed in the foreground, hands relaxed in her shorts pockets. Behind her, paint a giant hand-painted mural portrait of the same woman with flowing black hair, filling most of the wall, partly obscured by the real player in front. Use bold red and white diagonal brush strokes across the wall, black paint splatters, drips, and street-art texture.
